title: Cancelled Status Handling
description: Verify display state and interactive check-in controls for cancelled time slots
precondition: Appointment has been marked as Cancelled but originally scheduled time hour has not elapsed yet.
test_step_description: Locate the cancelled schedule rows block item card container.
test_step_expected_result: Portal displays the explicit status as Cancelled and blocks/disables UI interaction loops for online check-in operations.

title: Edge - Leap Year Handling
description: Verify schedule parser accurately handles edge leap dates without layout corruption
test_step_description: View appointment card details inside the calendar rendering layout.
test_step_expected_result: System displays the leap date 'February 29, 2028' cleanly without structural system calculations shifting dates forward to March.

title: No Appointments Layout
description: Verify standard text message visualization when patient has zero upcoming appointments
precondition: Target profile is verified to have zero upcoming rows populated.
test_step_description: Open the 'My Appointments' page directory link.
test_step_expected_result: System gracefully displays flat textual context string reading exactly: 'You have no upcoming appointments.'

title: Negative - Inactive Enrollment
description: Verify claim is rejected if patient enrollment status is inactive
test_step_expected_result: Adjudication engine immediately rejects claim with denial code 'ERR-ENR-01' (Inactive Enrollment).
